performance_question: With the AIPerf 0.12.0 mmap cursor race removed only in the load generator, how far can one Nix-built Envoy generic-with-callouts gateway scale on the original Mooncake trace as offered request rate rises beyond 6053 RPS?
comparison_limit: The fixed-reader client is a new measurement instrument. Re-measure the 12-client bridge point under this plan; treat the earlier unpatched 6043.92 RPS point as context, not as a direct same-series delta.
user_workload_note: This gateway-only mocker campaign predates and is outside the DGD recipe-optimization workload contract; its frozen trace and this plan are the run contract.

trace.replay_policy: Each client replays one immutable original trace with the same per-client timestamps; only client count changes across the predeclared capacity grid.
trace.mmap_cache: require HIT on every client; no measured-phase tokenizer or composer work

load.warmup: none, matching the historical clean Mooncake point
load.early_stop: Stop before a higher-load point when the lower point shows AIPerf errors, gateway HTTP errors, or load-generator saturation that makes the offered schedule untrustworthy.

instrument.version_selection: Reference-reproduction exception: retain the historical pinned AIPerf 0.12.0 image while applying one explicit reader patch.
instrument.overlay_mechanism: ConfigMap volume plus PYTHONPATH sitecustomize; replaces only MemoryMapDatasetClient.get_conversation seek/read with cursor-free mmap slice. Every Job Pod proves the replacement is loaded before profiling.
instrument.parser: AIPerf profile_export_aiperf.json; request-level JSONL unavailable at this export level

evidence_limit: Summary-level exports support achieved-throughput characterization but not independent request-ID or tail-SLO audit; no production-GPU or promotion claim is permitted.
run_policy: Preflight vCluster-only placement, bundle identity, patch digest, and component readiness. Serialize all benchmark Jobs; preserve failed attempts under unique names. Check every Pod for patch activation, mmap cache HIT, and tokenizer/composer skip.
